resolver.inputs: printed name, last list year (read year = last list year + 1), side (efv_dataset._side_match); SIDE then RECENCY tiebreaks on pre-read minor league lines
resolver.never_reads: debut date, major league line, WAR, stored id, birth date; never /people/search

flag.name: BUST_POOL_IDS
flag.reads_blocked: the builder refuses this file while symmetry.blocked

label_epoch.reading: pre-epoch: the label is the retiring provider; the balance read is re-run on the frozen label at the flag's flip

symmetry.rule: id coverage of debuted rows (debuts.json) and bust rows (inactive.json) under the same resolver, all rows, per side; a gap above max_gap_points on either side blocks any use of the ids in a training matrix
